  "text": "The stone cracked under the constable’s heel. Ada caught a glimpse of three letters before dust filled the grooves: OPE.

Venn cried out. The fingertip had hooked into his coat and was drawing him toward the splinter. Elias seized his collar. For a moment they held him between them, his boots scraping uselessly on the boards.

“Which side?” Ada demanded.

The constable backed away from the door. “I don’t know.”

The voice behind it laughed once. The black line on the floor tightened around his boot, and he fell to one knee. His ring struck the boards with a sound like a key turning.

A memory crossed his face so plainly that Ada knew it before he spoke.

“There was a fire,” he said. “I heard knocking. I opened the door.”

The handle jerked beneath Venn’s hand.

“You locked it afterward,” Ada said. “What did you leave inside?”

The constable stared at the ring. “My hand.”

The thing in the splinter flexed. Its nail was black with soot. Ada looked at the constable’s fingers, all five of them, and understood why he kept touching the ring.

“Take it off,” she said.

He pulled. The ring would not move. Elias let go of Venn long enough to draw his knife, but the constable shook his head and pressed his palm flat to the floor.

The black line rushed up his sleeve. Behind the yellow door, someone began to scream—not in the constable’s voice this time.

The ring slipped free. It rolled across the boards and stopped against Ada’s knee. Inside its band, in letters too small to read until she lifted it, was a name: MARA."
